specs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create ONE finished Brazilian Portuguese paid social advertising image, portrait aspect ratio 4:5, ideally 1080x1350. Brand Fátima Criança, selling children's TOYS to parents and grandparents at Christmas. Professional retail graphic design, instantly readable on mobile, large bold friendly rounded type, impeccable Portuguese accents, generous breathing room. Bright brand yellow #FCCF00, navy #344676, orange #F17036 with tasteful Christmas red accents and small pine sprigs and gift ribbon graphics. Toys must be immediately prominent; real supplied photographs are the heroes. Use reference photos as actual photographic inserts; keep products, packaging, proportions and store appearance faithful. Do not invent products or redesign packaging. Reference logo is brand identity: preserve its lettering and emblem faithfully, use small but legible. No invented prices, discounts, installment plans, delivery promises, countdowns, phone numbers, age suitability or claims beyond supplied copy. Crop out any shelf price placards if possible. Exact copy below is the ONLY advertising text. Do not add labels or descriptions. Footer CTA is a plain high-contrast text band and small downward arrow pointing toward the platform button BELOW the image, not a fake clickable button. Keep all essential content at least 5% inside edges. Full bleed final artwork only, no mockup/device, no borders around whole image, no contact sheet.
Concept: warm Christmas gift selection, hero for both parents and grandparents. Two large product photographs (Barbie mermaid and LEGO racecar held in hand) arranged as elegant overlapping rectangular photo prints in the middle, approximately 55% of image. Preserve actual photos, no reimagined standalone toys. Cream upper background, navy headline, yellow lower brand footer; a red ribbon and small pine branch at edge suggest Christmas without competing. Reference 1 and 2 are photo inserts; reference 3 is logo. Header small brand logo, then exact dominant headline with line breaks:
"Neste Natal,"
"presenteie com"
"BRINQUEDOS!"
Secondary sentence: "Para surpreender filhos e netos."
Footer exact two lines:
"Clique no botão abaixo e"
"fale com nossos atendentes"
